title: fix(router): respect strict trailing-slash routing
body:
`LinearRouter` and `PatternRouter` now distinguish paths with and without a trailing slash, consistent with the other routers under `strict: true`. Routes registered with a trailing slash require it, and optional root parameters such as `/:id?` continue to match `/`.

Some changes overlap with #5407, #5410, and #5461, but I couldn't adopt any of those PRs as-is. This PR provides a separate implementation and consolidates regression coverage in the shared router tests.

Fixes #5406.

### The author should do the following, if applicable

- [x] Add tests
- [x] Run tests
- [x] `pnpm run check:fix` to format and lint the code

files.patch:
@@ -10,11 +10,17 @@ export class PatternRouter<T> implements Router<T> {
   #routes: Route<T>[] = []
 
   add(method: string, path: string, handler: T) {
-    const suffix = path.endsWith('/*') ? '(?:$|/)' : path.endsWith('*') ? '' : '/?$'
+    const suffix = path.endsWith('/*')
+      ? '(?:$|/)'
+      : path.endsWith('*')
+        ? ''
+        : path.endsWith('/')
+          ? '/$'
+          : '$'
     path = path.replace(/\*$/, '')
     if (path.at(-1) === '?') {
       path = path.slice(0, -1)
-      this.add(method, path.replace(/\/[^/]+$/, ''), handler)
+      this.add(method, path.replace(/\/[^/]+$/, '') || '/', handler)
     }
